document.abstract: Ten 16mm cameras have been coupled for the synchronous photography of a 360° field, Special consideration was given to the selection of the cameras, as well as to the mechanical coupling, optical integration, structure of the assembly, and electrical controls. Some of the alternatives were influenced strongly by script and reliability considerations. Relationships between photography and projection also played a part in the rationale of the design.
